en.description: A survey of affective dynamics in human–AI agent collaboration: computational mechanisms, collaboration effects, deployment risk configurations, and measurement and governance — 128 graded references.
en.ogTitle: Affective Dynamics in Human–AI Agent Collaboration | Junjie Xu
en.titleHtml: Affective Dynamics in Human–AI Agent Collaboration: Mechanisms, Risks, and Governance.
en.subtitle: When agents plan, remember, call tools, and act — affect stops being a tone choice and becomes part of the collaboration infrastructure.
en.authors: Junjie Xu, Xingjiao Wu, Zihao Zhang, Yujia Xu, Yuzhe Yang, Jin Zhu, Luwei Xiao, Wen Wu, Liang He · East China Normal University & National University of Singapore
en.tldr: Warmth, confidence, apology, validation, simulated empathy — in agentic systems these are not stylistic choices: they shape when people trust, delegate, verify, correct, or disengage. This survey integrates affective computing, trust in automation, human–AI interaction, LLM-agent research, and AI governance into one account of affective dynamics, distinguishing affective expression, perceived agent affect, and genuine emotion, and treating affect as the coordination layer through which humans and agents negotiate capability, uncertainty, and responsibility.

stats.label: references synthesized across five research literatures
families of computational mechanisms that generate affective behaviour
collaboration pathways through which affective cues alter reliance and oversight
constructs kept distinct: expression, perceived affect, genuine emotion

sections.heading: The question
paragraphs:
Much of human–computer interaction has treated the system as an instrument: people formulate goals, interpret context, and bear responsibility, while software responds to commands. LLM-based agents make that division harder to maintain — they plan over longer horizons, remember across sessions, call tools, and act within delegated scopes.

In these settings, affective expression stops being decoration. Warmth, confidence, apology, and simulated empathy can shift whether a user trusts a plan, delegates a decision, verifies an output, or disengages entirely. The evidence lives in five literatures — affective computing, trust in automation, human–AI interaction, LLM-agent research, and AI governance — but each field rarely explains what changes once systems acquire memory, tool use, and partial autonomy. That gap is the survey's object.

figure.label: Fig. 1
figure.alt: Framework overview: affective dynamics as the coordination layer between human and AI agent, with the interaction loop, computational generators, and calibration mechanisms
figure.caption: The survey's framing — affective dynamics as the coordination layer of human–AI agent collaboration: an interaction loop, the computational generators of affective behaviour, and the calibration mechanisms around them.

sections.heading: The approach
paragraphs:
The survey is organized around one loop and four layers. The affective interaction loop runs from user affect through affective input cues, model affective expression, and perceived agent affect, back to human behavioural response — branching into calibrated collaboration or one of several risk paths.

On top of that loop, the survey synthesizes four families of computational mechanisms (sensing and response generation; emotional prompting; persona, memory, and affective continuity; alignment and safety gating including sycophancy), traces five collaboration pathways (trust calibration, delegation and autonomy, error detection and repair, anthropomorphism and dependence, feedback loops and co-adaptation), maps deployment configurations where those pathways turn risky, and reviews measurement and governance tools for calibrated affective alignment.

Two methodological commitments run throughout: claims are graded by evidence strength and directness to agentic systems, and causal language is matched to study design — so correlational findings are never quietly promoted to causal ones.

figure.label: Fig. 2
figure.alt: The affective interaction loop: user affect, affective input cues, model affective expression, perceived agent affect, and human behavioural response, branching into calibrated collaboration or risk paths
figure.caption: The affective interaction loop — five stages from user affect to behavioural response, with the branch points where collaboration becomes calibrated or risky.

sections.heading: What it contributes
paragraphs:
First, a defensible attribution stance: current agents have interactional expression and user-perceived affective roles, not subjective feeling — and conflating the two is where both over-claiming and under-regulating start.

Second, an integrated framework that treats affect as a coordination layer: the medium through which humans and agents negotiate capability, uncertainty, and responsibility — not a tone dial on the output.

Third, a risk gradient from mechanism to configuration: which combinations of memory, autonomy, and affective expression make the collaboration pathways dangerous, with governance and regulatory tools mapped along that gradient.

And fourth, an explicit register of where agent-specific longitudinal evidence remains missing — the survey marks its own gaps rather than papering over them.

zh.description: 人–AI 智能体协作中的情感动态综述：计算机制、协作效应、部署风险配置与测量治理，128 篇分级参考文献。
zh.ogTitle: 人–AI 智能体协作中的情感动态 | 许俊杰
zh.titleHtml: 人–AI 智能体协作中的情感动态：机制、风险与治理。
zh.subtitle: 当智能体会规划、会记忆、会调用工具、会行动——情感表达就不再是一种语气选择，而成为协作基础设施的一部分。
zh.authors: 许俊杰 等 · 华东师范大学 与 新加坡国立大学
zh.tldr: 温暖、自信、道歉、认可、被模拟出的共情——在智能体系统里这些不是风格选择：它们影响人们何时信任、何时托付、何时核查、何时纠正、何时退出。本综述把情感计算、自动化信任、人机交互、LLM 智能体研究与 AI 治理五支文献整合为一个关于情感动态的完整叙述，严格区分情感表达、被感知的智能体情感与真实情绪三类构念，并把情感视为人与智能体协商能力、不确定性与责任的协调层。

stats.label: 篇参考文献，横跨五支研究文献的分级综合
类产生情感行为的计算机制
条情感线索改变依赖与监督的协作路径
个被严格区分的构念：表达、被感知情感、真实情绪

sections.heading: 问题是什么
paragraphs:
传统人机交互大多把系统当作工具：人设定目标、理解语境、承担责任，软件照令执行。基于大模型的智能体让这种分工难以为继——它们跨更长周期地规划、跨会话地记忆、调用工具，并在被授权的范围内行动。

在这样的设定里，情感表达不再是装饰。温暖、自信、道歉与模拟共情会改变用户是否信任一个方案、是否托付一个决策、是否核查一个输出、或者干脆退出。相关证据分散在情感计算、自动化信任、人机交互、LLM 智能体与 AI 治理五支文献中，但每一支都很少回答：当系统拥有记忆、工具使用与部分自主性之后，到底什么变了。这个空档正是本综述的对象。

figure.label: 图 1
figure.alt: 综述框架总览：情感动态作为人机智能体协作的协调层，含交互闭环、计算生成器与校准机制
figure.caption: 综述的总体框架——情感动态作为人–AI 智能体协作的协调层：交互闭环、情感行为的计算生成器，以及围绕它们的校准机制。

sections.heading: 怎么做
paragraphs:
综述围绕一条闭环与四层结构展开。情感交互闭环从用户情感出发，经过情感输入线索、模型情感表达、被感知的智能体情感，回到人类行为响应——并分叉为校准的协作或若干风险路径。

在闭环之上，综述综合了四类计算机制（感知与响应生成、情感化提示、人格与记忆与情感连续性、对齐与安全门控含谄媚问题），追踪五条协作路径（信任校准、托付与自主性、错误检测与修复、拟人化与依赖、反馈回路与共同适应），刻画让这些路径变得危险的部署配置，并梳理面向校准情感对齐的测量与治理工具。

两条方法论承诺贯穿全文：论断按证据强度与到智能体系统的直接程度分级；因果措辞与实验设计严格匹配——相关发现不会被悄悄升格为因果结论。

figure.label: 图 2
figure.alt: 情感交互闭环：用户情感、情感输入线索、模型情感表达、被感知的智能体情感与人类行为响应，分叉为校准协作或风险路径
figure.caption: 情感交互闭环——从用户情感到行为响应的五个阶段，以及协作走向校准或风险的分叉点。

sections.heading: 贡献是什么
paragraphs:
其一，一个可辩护的归因立场：当前智能体拥有的是交互性表达与用户感知到的情感角色，而非主观感受——混淆这两者，正是过度宣称与监管不足共同的起点。

其二，一个整合框架，把情感当作协调层：人与智能体借以协商能力、不确定性与责任的媒介，而不是输出上的语气旋钮。

其三，一条从机制到配置的风险梯度：记忆、自主性与情感表达的哪些组合会让协作路径变得危险，并沿这条梯度映射治理与监管工具。

其四，一份明确的智能体专属纵向证据缺口清单——综述标出自己的边界，而不是掩盖它们。
